neighbours.label: The future auxiliary 'will' (and 'll), strongest in relative clauses and questions ('which will', 'How will'); quiet on the noun 'will', past-tense rewrites and other modals.
fire: The new bridge, which will connect the two islands, is still under construction.
Engineers built a reservoir that will supply the city for fifty years.
How will the council pay for the new stadium?
The coach says he'll be announcing the squad on Friday.
Scientists have found a comet which will pass close to Earth next year.
Where will the refugees sleep once the camp is closed?
The drought is a crisis that will affect farmers for a generation.
My sister says she'll be moving to Lisbon in the spring.
quiet: The new bridge, which connected the two islands, was finished last year.
Engineers built a reservoir that supplied the city for fifty years.
The old farmer left the farm to his nephew in his will.
The coach says he announced the squad on Friday.
Scientists have found a comet which passed close to Earth last year.
The debate about free will has lasted for centuries.
The drought was a crisis that affected farmers for a generation.
My sister says she moved to Lisbon in the spring.

predictions: median fire ~0.45 (probes: 'which will' 0.86, 'How will' 0.48, 'she'll' 0.38, 'that will' 0.30); near misses < 0.15 (past tense 0.02-0.03, noun 'his will' 0.14, 'Free will' 0.05). A 'can' sentence peaked 0.23 on another word, so near misses avoid modals.
